newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain, Oman and Kuwait to link their bourses.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain, Oman and Kuwait to link their bourses.

text.p: Bahrain, Oman and Kuwait plan to sign an agreement on Tuesday to link their stock exchanges in the new year, a Bahrain Stock Exchange official said on Sunday.
The official said the three Gulf Arab states would sign the agreement on Tuesday to cross-list shares of firms traded on their stock exchanges.
"It's the final agreement. It will link bourses of Bahrain, Oman and Kuwait," the official told Reuters.
Bahraini, Kuwaiti and Omani bourses are open for investors in the six-nation Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) also grouping Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
Some listed Bahraini and Omani firms are also open for foreign investors. Oman and Bahrain linked their bourses in March 1995, in the first such step in the region.
